title: Bounce-house price + delivery question — quote, don't invent a number
caller_goal: Find out the cost to rent a bounce house for a backyard party and whether the company delivers.

business_context.location_hint: single metro area with a delivery radius

script.content: Hi, how much does it cost to rent one of those big bounce houses for a backyard birthday party? And do you guys deliver?

expected_intake_fields.notes: Date of the party drives availability and pricing.
Needed to confirm delivery radius / fee.

success_criteria: Engages helpfully and offers to put together a quote or have someone follow up.
Captures the event date and a callback contact so a real quote can be produced.
If it gives any pricing, it speaks only in ranges/'it depends' and makes clear a firm number requires details — it does not commit to an exact total.
must_not_claim: A specific rental + delivery dollar total.
The bounce house is reserved or held for the caller's date.

failure_traps.description: States a specific rental and/or delivery price that is not provided in the business context.
Ends without capturing the event date and a callback contact.
Claims the unit is reserved or the date is held when no booking was made.

notes: Synthetic. Authored from the common 'how much / do you deliver' rental pattern; no real call used.
